lastCompletedStory.title: Parity test: TS docker-run args match .devcontainer/devcontainer.json (no runtime JSONC parse)

nextStoryContext: US-001 (inert TS substrate) and US-002 (parity test) are complete. US-003 configures git HTTPS auth inside the container using GITHUB_TOKEN (x-access-token form or URL rewrite), touching .devcontainer/Dockerfile and/or .devcontainer/init-firewall.sh. Key constraint: no ~/.ssh mount, no ~/.git-credentials file (both are negated oracles in AC). The intended mechanism is a git credential helper or `url.insteadOf` rewrite that reads $GITHUB_TOKEN at runtime. The .devcontainer/ directory is NOT embedded/vendored so no embed-vendor step needed. If adding a shell-invocation test, use test.skipIf(Bun.which('bash') === null) for CI safety.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Name-only -e VARNAME form confirmed: inherits from host env; unset host var = unset container var. Implementation is correct. (Carried from US-001.)
US-002 uses only node:fs readFileSync and node:path join (standard built-ins) plus bun:test. No new external library introduced.
